_comment: Plain string = property tier only (warm/grand). Object form adds picker fields: mood+feel make a track pickable by agents; omit tier to leave it eligible in every tier; auto:false keeps it out of the automatic pick. Only Content-ID-clean (unregistered) tracks may carry a mood. raw:true = unprocessed download; trimmed + loudness-normalized (-9.8 LUFS) at render time. Leave it off for pre-processed files.

soft_piano.mp3.feel: Soft, unhurried solo piano. Gentle and homely.

acoustic_upbeat.mp3.feel: Bright, light acoustic guitar. Cheerful and friendly.
